a.lede: I respect Apple's first crack at a foldable phone, but I'm not sure I like it.
a.title: Apple iPhone Duo review: Two screens, two experiences, two thousand dollars

b.lede: Company says small number of devices affected by display glitch after posts appear on Reddit and social media Owners of the new foldable iPhone are reporting cracks in the device’s screen, as Apple confirmed an issue with a “small number” of units. Reports of cracks have emerged on Reddit and social media platforms since the handset went on general sale
b.title: iPhone Duo owners report cracks in Apple’s first foldable handset
